agent_answer:
The conversations show Rashida and Preet are close friends in the group who share a passion for record collecting and go to record fairs together. Their dynamic is playful and teasing:

- They plan to attend fairs together — "Preet and I will go together and actually have fun" (said by Rashida, about going with Preet).
- They rib each other about their spending habits. Preet is the impulsive buyer who keeps picking up extra records ("I tried to stop her at three but the fourth one had incredible sleeve art"; "I went back... and bought three more records 😅"), while Rashida claims to be on a "strict budget" this time — only to be teased in return: "Rashida said that last time 😂."
- The teasing is affectionate and includes celebrating improvement — "I watched her walk away from THREE records today. growth 👏" — suggesting they observe and cheer on each other's restraint.

So: Rashida and Preet are friendly, bantering companions within the group who bond over record fairs and gently mock each other's (lack of) self-control when it comes to buying records.
